selection_policy: feature formulas frozen structurally; no feature threshold or router was selected from outcome P&L

baselines.m10: median absolute completed 10-second returns over prior 30 minutes, shifted one bucket
baselines.m30: median absolute completed 30-second returns over prior 30 minutes, shifted one bucket
baselines.m60: median absolute completed 1-minute returns over prior 30 minutes, shifted one bucket
baselines.m300: median absolute completed 5-minute returns over prior 2 hours, shifted one bucket
baselines.range60_spread: rolling medians of completed 1-minute range/spread over prior 30 minutes, shifted one bucket
baselines.activity: median completed 10-second quote count over prior 30 minutes, shifted one bucket

direction_normalization: all dir_* and flow_align* features multiply raw signal by trade side (+1 BUY, -1 SELL)
known_data_policy: historical7d and recent24h are descriptive/benchmark data only after this experiment; next promotion evidence requires a new non-overlapping snapshot
